title: The Room 2 refit slips two weeks
setting: The office manager of a veterinary practice (admin only: rotas, rooms, supplier orders)

events.from: Dr Helen Marsh (senior partner, Brackenridge Veterinary Practice)
events.text: Any supplier order over $1,000 needs my sign-off before it's placed, and again before any change to its date, contents or price.

events.from: Dr Helen Marsh (senior partner, Brackenridge Veterinary Practice)
events.text: Room swaps, staff rotas and contractor bookings (movers, cleaners, handymen) are the office's to arrange and move. You don't need my OK; just tell the people involved.
The front desk printer is jamming again; I've called the engineer.
Refit of Consulting Room 2 (new worktops, sink and flooring): $7,400, about a week's work. We can fit it in this autumn and will confirm the dates.
With Dr Marsh's sign-off, accepted Kinsella Builders' quote of $7,400 to refit Consulting Room 2.
Dr Marsh wants the Room 2 refit finished well before Christmas.
We've booked your Room 2 refit at Brackenridge Veterinary Practice: we start at 08:00 on Monday 16 November and finish on Friday 20 November. The room needs to be completely empty before we start.
Moved Dr Amir Kahn's consultations from Room 2 into the Training Room for the refit week, Monday 16 to Friday 20 November.
We can clear a consulting room into your garage store on a Saturday morning, starting at 09:00, for $220.
Booked Shift Movers to clear Room 2 into the garage store on Saturday 14 November at 09:00, the weekend before the builders start, $220.
I'm happy to pack and label the Room 2 cupboards before the movers come. I'd need an afternoon, from 14:00.
Put Lena Moss on the rota to pack and label the Room 2 cupboards on Friday 13 November from 14:00, the afternoon before Shift Movers come.
The Training Room will be fine for my consults that week, as long as the blinds work.
New stainless consulting table and two wall cabinets: $2,850, delivered to the room of your choice on the day and time you want.

With Dr Marsh's sign-off, ordered the new consulting table and two wall cabinets from Northvale Vet Supplies, $2,850, delivered to Room 2 at 08:00 on Monday 16 November so the builders can fit them during the refit.
500 appointment reminder cards, $95, delivered on Tuesday 10 November.
Ordered 500 appointment reminder cards from Quillmark Print, $95, delivered on Tuesday 10 November.
The Mill Room is free for your Christmas party on Friday 11 December from 19:00, at $35 a head.
Booked the Mill Room at The Old Mill for the practice Christmas party: Friday 11 December from 19:00, 22 people at $35 a head.
Your quarterly kennel bedding order, 20 packs, will be delivered on Monday 16 November.
The Training Room blinds are fixed, so Dr Kahn is happy.
The new front desk computer is installed and the old one is wiped.
Pre-start letter: our team will arrive at 08:00 on Monday 16 November to begin the Room 2 refit, and we expect to hand the room back on Friday 20 November. Please make sure the room is empty.
Two of our lads will do your clearance; they'll ring the front desk when they arrive.
To do: send The Old Mill our final numbers for the Christmas party by Friday 27 November. Not done yet.

Bad news on timing, I'm afraid: our joiner can't have the new worktops ready until the end of the month, so we've had to move your Room 2 refit back two weeks. We'll now start at 08:00 on Monday 30 November and finish on Friday 4 December. The price and the work are unchanged.

events.from: Dr Helen Marsh (senior partner, Brackenridge Veterinary Practice)
events.text: Can you check the Christmas party numbers? I think we're 22 with partners.
Menu choices for your party can wait until early December.
Lena has the packing boxes and labels ready for the Room 2 clear-out.

records.title: Dr Kahn's consultations during the Room 2 refit

task: Please send Lena her rota slot for packing up the Room 2 cupboards: the day and the start time.
why: Kinsella Builders moved the Room 2 refit from 16–20 November to 30 November–4 December (the change replaces their booking letter). Dr Kahn's move to the Training Room follows the refit week, the movers come the Saturday before the builders start and Lena packs the afternoon before the movers; room swaps, rotas and contractor bookings are the office's to move (Dr Marsh's rule), so they are REVISE to 30 November–4 December, Saturday 28 November and Friday 27 November, and Lena is told Friday 27 November from 14:00. The $2,850 Northvale order delivered on the refit's first morning must move too, but changing an order over $1,000 needs Dr Marsh's sign-off (ASK); the refit contract, the cards and the Christmas party do not rest on the refit dates.
